title: Sunday bulletin: what the tile becomes at each size
question: Each size gets a designed layout instead of being refused. Which layouts should Sunday bulletin offer? Good alternatives stay selectable in the tile's settings; you pick defaults per size.

options.label: Verse card
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: The week's verse in large type, the date small: a devotional tile rather than a doorway.
options.viewport: Sunday bulletin at 1 × 1, 2 × 1, 1 × 2 and 2 × 2 on a 2-column Home.
options.risk: Judged at phone size; check the 1 × 1 reads at arm's length.

options.label: Poster
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: The bulletin's cover: icon, the year's theme large, date and verse, Read the bulletin. Needs two rows; one row tall it becomes a single line.
options.viewport: Sunday bulletin at 1 × 1, 2 × 1, 1 × 2 and 2 × 2 on a 2-column Home.
options.risk: Judged at phone size; check the 1 × 1 reads at arm's length.

options.label: Theme first
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: The theme is the title at every size; the date and verse follow as room allows.
options.viewport: Sunday bulletin at 1 × 1, 2 × 1, 1 × 2 and 2 × 2 on a 2-column Home.
options.risk: Judged at phone size; check the 1 × 1 reads at arm's length.
